verdict.rationale: The BYOK docs explicitly say you can "skip authentication entirely by configuring BYOK for every provider you use," so no requests go through the stagewise managed service. Provider API keys (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, custom or self-hosted endpoints) can be configured per provider in place of a stagewise Account. Community complaints about account sign-up friction concern the account flow itself and do not contradict the BYOK path. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that a fully BYOK setup works with no account login.
